title: COTA Track Guide: Every Corner of the Circuit of the Americas Explained #f1 #f1analysis #formula1
description:
One lap of the Circuit of the Americas, corner by corner.

Turn 1 is the one everyone remembers. The run to it climbs about 40 m, the apex is blind, and the cars drop from 285 km/h to 85 km/h in roughly 110 m. It's also where the most happens: 31% of racing passes at COTA are made on the run to Turn 1 or through it.

Then the esses. Turns 3 to 9 are modelled on Silverstone's Maggotts and Becketts, with almost no braking. Apex speeds fall from 268 km/h at Turn 3 to 192 km/h at Turn 6.
